Question 10
?

Consider the function f(x)=6cos⁡(3x−π4). Which expression gives all of the values of x at which f(x) attains its maximum value? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=π12+2nπ3
b
x=π12+nπ3
c
x=π6+nπ3
d
x=π12+6nπ
e
x=π6+2nπ3
